summaries: A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD statistical release reporting new residential construction statistics for August 2022 (released September 20, 2022). Relevant to the task, Table 3a provides seasonally adjusted annual rates (SAAR) for housing starts by region, specifically detailing the South and Midwest for July 2022 (revised) and August 2022 (preliminary). This document enables the evaluation of the month-over-month change for the first month of the requested 2022/08–2025/05 timeframe. According to Table 3a, South housing starts increased from July to August (711 to 885 thousand), but Midwest housing starts also increased (167 to 196 thousand); consequently, August 2022 does not satisfy the task condition (South Increase AND Midwest Decrease). The document contributes data for August 2022 only, requiring other sources for the remainder of the 2022–2025 period.

A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD statistical release on New Residential Construction for September 2022 (Release Number CB22-174, released October 19, 2022). Relevant to the task: Table 3a lists seasonally adjusted housing starts for the South and Midwest regions, covering July through September 2022. It provides revised data for July and August 2022 and preliminary data for September 2022, enabling the verification of month-over-month trends for the initial segment of the requested 2022/08–2025/05 timeframe. Specifically, the document shows South starts decreased (-13.7%) and Midwest starts decreased (-2.7%) in September 2022, while both regions increased in August 2022 compared to July. This serves as the primary source for the September 2022 data point, though its values are subject to supersession by later reports in the collection.
